NEXUS 1.8 EXECUTION COMPLETION OBSERVABILITY — NO BEHAVIOR CHANGE.

Do not modify completion semantics, Planner, Understanding, TaskContract, EvidenceLedger, tool routing, speed policy, or execution control flow.

We have proven that completion_contract(plan) is active for the live smoke plan. The remaining ambiguity is whether evaluate_execution_completion() is silently returning PASS because progress may be None or because PASS decisions are not persisted.

Add deterministic observability only.

In the no-tool completion path, persist an execution_completion_gate event for both PASS and CONTINUE, containing:

iteration

verdict

allow

summary

unmet_conditions

next_focus

proposed_final_length

evidence_count or equivalent evidence summary count

Also, when self.live is true, print the completion verdict for both branches:

EXECUTION COMPLETION GATE PASS

or

EXECUTION COMPLETION GATE CONTINUE

Do not rely only on the evaluator's optional progress callback for user-visible observability.

Immediately before the sole normal success return, persist a second event:

execution_success_return

with:

iteration

completion_verdict

final_length

status

This is instrumentation only. Do not alter whether PASS or CONTINUE is chosen.

Add deterministic tests proving:

a PASS decision produces an execution_completion_gate event with verdict=PASS;
a CONTINUE decision produces the same event with verdict=CONTINUE;
normal success return can only occur after a recorded PASS;
no task_progress dependency is reintroduced.

Run targeted tests and the full regression suite. Run git diff --check. Reinstall the dev build.

Do not run a live smoke test. Do not bump version, commit, tag, push, or publish.
